sum_insured_options: ₹3,00,000 (as per illustrations; exact range not fully specified in wording)

room_rent.display: 1% of SI/day OR Twin Sharing OR Single Private AC Room
room_rent.note: Policy Schedule specifies which applies: Room Rent = 1% of SI/day, or Room Category 1 (Twin Sharing), or Room Category 2 (Single Private AC). If higher room taken, Associate Medical Expenses are pro-rated.

icu.display: 2% of SI/day OR No limit (as per schedule)
icu.note: ICU Charges Option 1 = 2% of Benefit 1 SI per day; ICU Charges Option 2 = no limit. Policy Schedule specifies which applies.

copayment.display: As per Policy Schedule (e.g. 20%/30%); +10% at age 71+
copayment.note: Co-payment percentage is specified in Policy Schedule. Increases by 10% per claim in policy year following insured (or eldest floater member) turning 71. Waiver of age-71 loading available on payment of extra premium. Co-payment not applicable on Benefit 2, 3, 5, 7, 9, Optional Cover 2 & 3.

sub_limits.display: Cataract, Knee Replacement, Hernia, Hysterectomy, BPH, Renal stones, Cardiovascular, Cancer, Renal complications, Bone fractures capped
sub_limits.note: Named Ailments/Procedures (Clause 3.1.1(c)(iii)) have sub-limits as specified in Policy Schedule. Domiciliary Hospitalization capped at 10% of SI.

deductible.note: Deductible amount is specified in Policy Schedule. Applies to aggregate of all claims. Not applicable on Benefit 7 (Recharge) and Benefit 9 (Health Check-up).

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses from first policy commencement date; not applicable for accidents.

ped_waiting.note: Pre-existing diseases covered after 24 months of continuous coverage. Reducible via portability credit.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Specific diseases/procedures (e.g. cataract, hernia, joint replacement, BPH, kidney stones, cancer, etc.) excluded for 24 months from first policy date. Not applicable for accidents.

maternity.note: Maternity is a permanent exclusion (Code Excl18). Ectopic pregnancy is covered. Lawful termination and miscarriage (unless accidental) excluded.

cumulative_bonus.note: Cumulative Bonus is defined in the policy but no specific rate or maximum percentage is stated in the wording provided.

restoration.note: Benefit 7: Recharge of Sum Insured reinstates up to 100% of SI once SI is fully exhausted. Not available for same illness/injury already claimed in that policy year. Cannot be carried forward. Not applicable to Optional Covers.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for a pre-defined number of days (not explicitly stated as a number in the wording; amount subject to Schedule of Benefits).

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for a pre-defined number of days immediately after discharge (not explicitly stated as a number in the wording; amount subject to Schedule of Benefits).

day_care.note: Day Care Treatment covered up to SI. Extensive list in Annexure I covering cardiology, ENT, gastroenterology, gynaecology, oncology, urology, orthopaedics, ophthalmology and more.

domiciliary.note: Benefit 6: Domiciliary Hospitalization covered up to 10% of SI for treatment exceeding 3 consecutive days. Several chronic conditions excluded (asthma, diabetes, hypertension, epilepsy, etc.).

ayush.note: Benefit 10: AYUSH (Ayurveda, Yoga, Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha, Homeopathy) covered up to SI via cashless or reimbursement at registered AYUSH hospitals, subject to in-patient care admissibility under Benefit 1.

organ_donor.note: Expenses related to donor treatment including surgery to remove organs from donor are permanently excluded (Clause 4.2(i)(12)).

ambulance.note: Benefit 5: Ambulance cover for emergency transportation to nearest hospital. Limit specified in Schedule of Benefits. Necessity must be certified by treating doctor.

modern_treatments.note: Clause 3.1.1(d) covers 12 specified advanced technology methods including robotic surgery, stereotactic radiosurgery, oral chemotherapy, immunotherapy, HIFU, deep brain stimulation, stem cell therapy (haematopoietic), etc. Other advance technology methods excluded.

consumables.note: Benefit 2 (Consumable Allowance) pays a fixed amount per completed 24-hour period of in-patient hospitalisation, not payable for first 3 days and capped at 7 consecutive days per illness/accident. Amount per Schedule of Benefits. No co-payment or deductible on this benefit.

global_cover.note: Policy explicitly covers only medical treatment taken within India (Clause 6.1.6(a)). Treatment outside India is a permanent exclusion (Clause 4.2(i)(15)).

moratorium.note: After 5 continuous years (60 months) no look-back applied. Claims not contestable except for proven fraud and permanent exclusions. Moratorium applies to original SI; fresh 5-year period starts on SI enhancement for enhanced portion.

grace_period.note: Grace period is 15 days for monthly premium payment mode and 30 days for all other modes. Coverage not available during grace period unless premium paid in instalments during policy period.

free_look.note: Applicable on new individual policies only; not on renewals or porting/migration.

portability.note: Portability to other insurers permitted as per IRDAI guidelines. Must apply at least 30 days before but not earlier than 60 days from renewal date.

notable_exclusions.display: Organ donor costs, OPD treatment, treatment outside India, RMO/surcharges, multifocal lens, Remicade/Avastin, 16 permanent pre-existing conditions (e.g. DVT, varicose veins, retinal detachment)

optional_riders.display: Good Health+ (OPD consultations & pharmacy discounts), Home Care (nurse hiring ₹1,000/day), Health Check+ (enhanced health check-up panels)
